name: Journey of the Voice
source:
Journey of the Voice is a take on the visual novel genre with a socially anxious protagonist who has trouble talking to others but has the dream of starting a band. Go out and meet weirdos to talk to at your buddy's bar, learn techniques to handle your social anxiety, recruit those weirdos to your band, write down lyrics for your song, and reflect on how far you've come so that you can perform with your band at the Battle of the Bands event. Remember, don't be afraid to put yourself out there to get to where you want to be in life.

[From [url=https://wearethem.itch.io/journey-of-the-voice]Itch.io[/url]]
